lines.text: a Focus on the Family booklet for women, 2001: “it is an identity crisis”
lines.source: Focus on the Family, The Heart of the Matter: The Roots and Causes of Female Homosexuality (© 2001), printed p. 14 (PDF p. 10): "The lesbian struggle is not a sexual orientation problem; it is an identity crisis." NMAH.AC.1428 B6 F4

lines.text: May 2012, the WHO's office for the Americas: homosexuality “requires no cure”
lines.source: Pan American Health Organization (Regional Office of the WHO), "'Cures' for an illness that does not exist" (position statement, May 2012), p. 1: "…does homosexuality constitute a disorder or an illness, and therefore it requires no cure"; news release 17 May 2012, paho.org/en/news/17-5-2012-therapies-change-sexual-orientation-lack-medical-justification-and-threaten-health; read 15 Nov 2026

lines.text: the same 2001 booklet: a mother “perceived as distant”; “defensive detachment”
lines.source: Focus on the Family, The Heart of the Matter (© 2001), printed p. 17 (PDF p. 11): "If mother is perceived as distant, bitter, critical, overbearing and unloving … defensive detachment"

lines.text: an Exodus booklet, 1993: the father's responses as “the score card”
lines.source: Exodus International–North America, booklet #PR-02 Are People Born Gay? (© 1993), printed p. 8 (PDF p. 6): "The responses from her father produce the score card of passing or failing as a little girl." NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F12

lines.text: a church's Living Waters group, 2016: 20 Monday evenings, $150, payment plans
lines.source: A church counselling centre's "Living Waters" group page, posted 29 March 2016 ("Monday evenings at 7 p.m. for 20 weeks"; "The cost is $150 (payment plans are available)"; "Groups fill up in a matter of days"), a public Squarespace page, read 15 Nov 2026 (its address carries a person's name, so it is not printed here)

lines.text: an Exodus booklet, 1993 — re-issued here, word for word, 2016
lines.source: Exodus International–North America, booklet #PR-02 Are People Born Gay? (© 1993), printed p. 19 (PDF p. 11): "To use a computer analogy … she has no file to put it in." NMAH.AC.1428 B2 F12 (read on the page image)

lines.text: 19 June 2013: Exodus closed at its own conference, and its president apologised
lines.source: Religion News Service in The Christian Century (24 July 2013 issue), "'Ex-gay' group closes as its president apologizes": closure announced June 19 at the ministry's 38th annual conference; christiancentury.org/article/2013-06/ex-gay-group-exodus-international-shuts-down-president-apologizes, read 15 Nov 2026

lines.text: 2014, Royal College of Psychiatrists: no sound evidence that orientation can change
lines.source: Royal College of Psychiatrists, Position Statement PS02/2014 (April 2014), p. 2: "There is no sound scientific evidence that sexual orientation can be changed." rcpsych.ac.uk (ps02_2014.pdf), read 15 Nov 2026
